{{Quote|Signal is being transmitted to the mining array."<br />"Signal received. Mining charges primed. Detonation in fifteen minutes.|A battle droid and the array's central computer|<ref name="HoBS">{{CWACite|5|Heroes on Both Sides (comic story)}}</ref>}}
[[File:Mining_array_computer.jpg|thumb|right|The central computer of a mining array on the planet Viidaav]]
A '''mining array''' was a command center that controlled the detonation of [[Mining charge/Legends|mining charges]]. A signal from the mining array's [[Computer/Legends|computer]] set a timer; after this counted down, sub-surface charges detonated. This was helpful in certain types of [[Mining/Legends|mining]], as that practiced on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Viidaav]]. Mining arrays could be housed in fortified bunkers with automated defense systems.
